definitions.explanation: Pads of fur or fleece worn over the ears against the cold, usually joined by a band over the head.

examples.japanese: {耳当|みみあ}て⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{寒|さむ}い→寒い：00664_samui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で{耳当|みみあ}て⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: It was cold, so I put on earmuffs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧、{子|こ}どもたち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ふわふわ→ふわふわ：05156_fuwafuwa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{耳当|みみあ}て⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: On the snowy day, the children went to school wearing fluffy earmuffs.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{耳|みみ}→耳：01513_mimi⟧ "ear" and {当|あ}て "something placed against." The loanword イヤーマフ is also used, especially for hearing protection.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {耳当|みみあ}て⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧/つける: to wear earmuffs
- {防寒用|ぼうかんよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{耳当|みみあ}て: earmuffs for the cold
- ⟦{手袋|てぶくろ}→手袋：01063_tebukuro⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{耳当|みみあ}て: gloves and earmuffs
